result.note: Geometry only; ok means inspection ran, not that the layout passed. No content index, resources or acceptance are required or changed. Overlap candidates include sibling foreground boxes and projected world/screen foreground intersections, exclude backgrounds and parent-child composition, and may be intentional. outsideCameraView diagnoses projected reference-plane geometry beyond framing, not runtime clipping/occlusion. Boundary checks probe declared variant transitions, not supported-size guarantees. Text metrics remain unmeasured without the actual font.
